terms.gloss: a book of pictures, a photo album
terms.comment: Our plain description, after the lexicon’s imāgō phōtographica for a photo (see photo).

terms.gloss: a white tablet; a list, register
terms.comment: The word English took, but classically a whitened board for public notices, the pontiffs’ annals or the praetor’s edicts, and so a list of names, as the roll of senators (Tac. A. 4.42) (Lewis & Short s.v. albus). Stretched to a book of photographs, it would be our sense.

sources: Lewis & Short: albus · Lewis & Short: imago
